description:
After months of appearing in sets throughout clubs and festival stages the world over, Dimitri Vegas, Bountyhunter and BRANDON finally release their hotly anticipated collaboration ‘WOOPS’ via Smash The House.

‘WOOPS’ has spent months picking up support from seemingly every corner of electronic music. It emerged as the #1 most-played track at both Ultra and Tomorrowland in 2026, underlining the unusual reach the track has already found.
 
The laundry list of DJs who have put ‘Woops’ into rotation is as varied as it is extensive. Anyma, Solomun, Dom Dolla, Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, Vintage Culture, Eli Brown, Odd Mob, Chris Lake, Cloonee, Cassian, Miss Monique, Nico Moreno, Novah, Lilly Palmer, Kevin de Vries, CamelPhat and many others, are among those supporting it from the underground, while at the other end of the electronic spectrum, Swedish House Mafia, Tiësto, The Chainsmokers, Armin van Buuren, Oliver Heldens, Diplo, and Afrojack have also been hammering the track, turning ‘Woops’ into a bona fide crossover between underground dancefloors and festival mainstages.

OUT SEPT 25th ON SMASH THE HOUSE

About #Kaskade:
Kaskade, born Ryan Raddon, has solidified his place as one of the most influential figures in electronic music. An eight-time GRAMMY Award nominee, he has spent decades pushing the boundaries of dance music while maintaining an unmistakably emotional core. In December 2025, he released undux, his most personal album to date, returning to introspective songwriting and emotional storytelling. Just four months later, he debuted his new live concept, Origin //, at Coachella, delivering one of the festival’s most talked-about performances. 

Kaskade’s influence extends far beyond the traditional electronic music circuit. In 2022, his collaboration with deadmau5, Kx5, set a record for the largest single-day concert headlined by an electronic artist in North America with their show at the LA Memorial Coliseum, while Billboard named it the biggest ticketed global headliner dance event of the year. The duo went on to grace the cover of Billboard and headline SXSW in 2023. A year later, Kaskade became the first-ever in-game DJ at the Super Bowl, performing for more than 123.4 million viewers, and the first-ever starting-grid DJ at Formula 1 in Miami. His expanding presence across sports and live events has included performances at the X Games, LIV Golf and Coachella, as well as a three-hour back-to-back set with Idris Elba in 2025. Across a career spanning decades, Kaskade continues to evolve while preserving the emotional connection that has made him one of dance music’s most enduring and devotedly followed artists.

About #Arkade:
Founded by Kaskade in 2014, Arkade is an independent record label and creative platform built around a simple idea: champion music Kaskade genuinely believes in and create space for artists and projects that deserve to be heard.

More recently, Arkade has continued evolving alongside Kaskade’s own creative output, including undux in 2025 and his forthcoming album ORIGIN //, while remaining rooted in the same principle that inspired its creation more than a decade ago: identifying compelling music, supporting creative risk, and building a platform for what comes next.

Today, Arkade operates as both the home of Kaskade’s expanding body of work and a broader creative ecosystem connecting releases, collaborations, live concepts, and artist development across generations of electronic music.
